name: BodyShopRepairEstimateManager
tagline: Estimate, authorise, repair and deliver – the collision repair workflow in one Power Apps component.
description: Complete body shop app for Canvas, Model-driven apps and Power Pages: estimate lines priced with panel, paint and materials rates, insurer authorisation with SLA tracking, supplements that block the job until approved, a repair stage board with business rules, QC checklist, excess collection, key-to-key, cycle time, on-time and supplement-ratio KPIs and insurer scorecards.
features: Estimate line editor (panel, paint, parts, materials, sublet, supplement lines)
Insurer authorisation with per-insurer SLA in working days
Stage board with drag-and-drop and rule checks
QC checklist and excess check before delivery
Key-to-key, cycle time, on-time and supplement-ratio KPIs
